vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope: isometric renderer — 3D cube projection and click mapping

narrative.Overview: Implement the isometric perspective rendering of the 3×3×3 cube on a pygame surface. Maps (x,y,z) cell coordinates to 2D screen polygons, detects which cell was clicked, and renders X/O markers and win-line highlights.
narrative.Requirements: FR-1 (isometric cube display), FR-3 (click-to-cell), FR-5 (win-line highlight), NFR-4 (click mapping correctness).
narrative.Tasks:
1. Define iso_project(x, y, z) -> (screen_x, screen_y) using standard isometric transform (tile_width/2 per x step, tile_height/2 per y step, z shifts up).
2. draw_cube(surface, board): iterate over all 27 cells, draw top and two visible side faces as filled polygons (back-to-front Z order for painter's algorithm).
3. draw_marker(surface, cell, player): render X or O centered on the top face of the cell at (x,y,z).
4. hit_test(screen_pos, board) -> int|None: for each visible cell, test if the click falls inside the top-face polygon; return cell index or None.
5. highlight_win_line(surface, win_cells): draw a contrasting line or glow through the 3 winning cells.
6. Write tests/test_renderer.py: hit_test returns the correct cell for the center pixel of every cell's top face (27 tests).
narrative.Acceptance: pytest tests/test_renderer.py passes. All 27 cells are clickable and correctly identified by hit_test.
